tasks.title: Define internet-document domain types
tasks.dod: src/types/internet-document.ts compiles with zero any; SaveInternetDocumentPayload/UpdateInternetDocumentPayload are the ServiceType x CargoType intersected type-sets per ADR-0001, never collapsed to shared fields; DeletedInternetDocumentOutcome is a per-Ref array shape, never T | undefined (ADR-0002); tsc --noEmit and lint pass

tasks.title: Implement save and update methods
tasks.dod: save/update each have a happy-path unit test (returns the saved/updated waybill incl. Ref and IntDocNumber) and an empty-on-success test (resolves undefined, does not throw); a compile-time test proves a payload mixing ServiceType/CargoType fields from different combinations fails to compile

tasks.title: Implement delete with per-Ref outcome reconciliation
tasks.dod: delete has a unit test asserting a single-Ref call resolves a one-element outcome array, and a batch call reconciles submitted Refs against Nova Poshta's confirmed-removed set so a Ref missing from the response surfaces as Removed:false with a Reason, never silently dropped

tasks.title: Implement getDocumentList, getDocumentPrice, and getDocumentDeliveryDate
tasks.dod: each of the three methods has a unit test for the unfiltered/no-linkage happy path, and getDocumentList has a second test asserting a documented filter (e.g. a date range) is passed through unmodified with no client-side re-filtering and no auto-paging when Page is omitted

tasks.title: Implement printDocument and printMarkings via a construct-then-verify helper
tasks.dod: a private buildAndVerifyPrintLink() helper builds the print URL and issues one fetch-based verification check, never through client.request(); printDocument/printMarkings each have a unit test for the success path (returns the URL string) and a mocked-fetch-failure test (throws NovaPoshtaApiError, never an empty or unverified link)

tasks.title: Wire internet-document module into the public package surface
tasks.dod: createInternetDocumentModule and its types import and type-check from nova-poshta-lib's public entry point; no cross-module runtime call to address or counterparty is added, and no Ref validation of its own is introduced
